review.scope: All 26 fixed B1 contexts. Nine original owned returns, three original inherited results, twelve source companions and two explicit Ecore mutations. No denominator or release acceptance change.
review.boundary: A complete native terminal outcome requires actual pinned dependencies and all applicable stages. A blocker, partial graph, prepared lifecycle flag or imported signature cannot close a context.

Every specified/Pilot disagreement has a reviewed normative disposition and focused verification.
Validate certificate inputs/stages/dependencies; only then close V01. Full service and strict family qualification remain separate.
batch_exit.broad_run_policy: No broad diagnostic to find the next local error. Full native obligation matrix at dependency-bundle boundary; broad comparisons after completed bundle.
